# Bird species classifier (10 classes, 64x64 RGB)

## Method
- Features (all inside the pickled Pipeline, `finalfeat.FullFeatures`):
  - HOG computed from scratch in numpy (8x8 cells, 9 orientation bins, 2x2 block L2-Hys normalization);
  - HSV and RGB colour histograms on a 4x4 spatial grid (6 bins/channel);
  - LBP-style code histograms on a 4x4 grid (256 codes pooled to 32);
  - unsupervised Coates–Ng patch features: 6x6 patches, contrast-normalized + ZCA whitened, k-means dictionary (k=256) learned on the training images, triangle activation coding, 3x3 spatial sum pooling.
- Classifier: StandardScaler + multinomial LogisticRegression (C=0.1), trained on the 300 training images plus their horizontal mirrors (600 samples).
- Model selection: 5-fold stratified CV on `data/train` only. Compared raw pixels, HOG/colour/LBP subsets, linear SVM / RBF SVM / chi2 SVM / logistic regression, patch dictionaries of several sizes (k=256/512, patch 4/6/8, stride 1/2), translation augmentation and flip-TTA. CV path: 0.58 (raw) → 0.69 (HOG+colour, RBF SVM) → 0.763 (HOG+colour+patch, LogReg) → 0.7967 (all blocks, C=0.1). Shifts, extra dictionaries and TTA gave no CV gain, so training was stopped and the best configuration refit once on all training data.

"""Final training: fit on all 300 training images + horizontal flips."""
import pickle, time
import numpy as np
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from data_utils import load_train, hflip
from finalfeat import FullFeatures

t = time.time()
X, y = load_train()
Xall = np.concatenate([X, hflip(X)]).astype(np.float32)
yall = np.tile(y, 2)

pipe = Pipeline([
    ("fe", FullFeatures(k=256, ps=6, stride=2, pool=3, n_patches=100000, seed=0)),
    ("sc", StandardScaler()),
    ("clf", LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=3000)),
])
pipe.fit(Xall, yall)
print("train acc", (pipe.predict(X) == y).mean(), f"{time.time()-t:.1f}s")
with open("model.pkl", "wb") as f:
    pickle.dump(pipe, f)
print("saved model.pkl")
